common.tagline: The tools you need, built by you
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

landing.title: An idea for a tool. Votes. Someone who builds it.
landing.subtitle: Post the tool you wish existed. If your class votes for it, a student takes it on and ships it.
landing.step1Body: Describe the problem you want gone. Two minutes is enough.
landing.step2Body: The most voted ideas rise to the top. Your class decides what matters.
landing.step3Body: Think you can build it? Claim the idea in one click, for 21 days.
landing.step4Body: Publish the tool and its link. It joins the gallery, visible to the whole school.

auth.signupDone: Account created. Open your inbox and click the confirmation link.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotDone: If an account exists for that address, the link is on its way.
auth.verifyBody: We sent a link to {email}. Until it's clicked, your account can see no data at all.
auth.errorDomain: That is not a school address. Use your {domains} email.
auth.errorPasswordShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
auth.errorEmailTaken: An account already exists for that address.

ideas.listSubtitle: Vote for the ones you want to exist.
ideas.empty: No ideas yet. Be the first to post one.
ideas.newSubtitle: A clear idea gets through review faster than a vague one.
ideas.fieldProblemHint: Describe the actual pain, not the solution.
ideas.newDone: Idea sent. An admin reviews it before it goes live.
ideas.duplicateBody: Vote for one of these rather than posting a second: votes count for more when they are not split.

claim.rulesTitle: Before you claim it, read this
claim.rule1: You have {days} days to ship. After that, the idea goes back to open.
claim.rule2: You can extend by {extension} days in one click if you're still on it.
claim.rule3: You can release the idea at any time, no explanation needed.
claim.rule4: Two active claims per person, maximum.
claim.releaseConfirm: Release this idea? It becomes available to everyone again.
claim.extend: I'm still on it, extend by {extension} days
claim.errorQuota: You already have {max} active claims. Ship or release one first.

delivery.title: Ship the tool
delivery.subtitle: The tool must already be live somewhere. This platform hosts nothing, it points to things.
delivery.fieldUrlHint: The address where anyone can use it right now.
delivery.fieldScreenshotsHint: 1 to 3 images, PNG or JPG, 5 MB each at most.
delivery.done: Project published. It's in the gallery.
delivery.errorUrl: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://

gallery.title: Shipped tools
gallery.subtitle: Built by students, usable right now.

me.title: My space
me.noIdeas: You haven't posted any idea yet.

admin.rejectReason: Reason for rejection, shown to the author

errors.not_verified: Confirm your email address before doing that.
errors.idea_not_open: This idea is no longer available.
errors.idea_not_pending: This idea has already been reviewed.
errors.claim_quota_reached: You already have two active claims.
errors.claim_not_releasable: That claim is no longer active.
errors.claim_not_extendable: That claim is no longer active.
errors.self_vote_not_allowed: You cannot vote for your own idea.
errors.reason_required: A reason is required to reject an idea.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove your own admin role.

home.title: What is moving right now
home.claimsBody: There is still time, but the idea reopens if you do not ship.
home.shippedEmpty: Nobody has shipped yet. The first card in the gallery will be yours.
home.ctaBody: Describe the problem in two minutes. If your class votes for it, someone will build it.
home.buildBody: Claim an idea in one click. You get {days} days, and you can release it whenever you want.

danger.title: Delete my account
danger.body: Your account, your votes and your personal details are removed at once. The ideas you posted and the tools you delivered stay online without your name, so other people's votes are not erased.
danger.release: Any idea you had claimed goes back on the board.
danger.failed: Deletion failed. Try again or write to the administrator.

profile.title: My profile
profile.body: Your name shows next to your ideas. Class year and campus are only used for filtering, and may be left empty.
